research.title: AI's Impact on Youth Mental Health
research.description: Exploring the psychological impact of AI on today's youth—from academic stress and flawed detectors to synthetic media trauma and chatbot reliance. Our initiative empowers young people with digital hygiene frameworks and advocates for human-centric AI solutions that protect mental wellbeing.
